verdict.rationale: Kit documents an official remote MCP server (the Kit MCP) that exposes a creator's account to MCP-compatible AI clients, covering subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments. It supports both reading and writing, so natural-language prompts become real account actions. A separate official Developer Docs MCP gives coding agents live access to the API reference, and a probe confirms the MCP docs are live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented client setup/authentication specifics for the MCP connection.
